summary: Harmony is an analytics platform that helps organizations make sense of messy data by transforming, cleaning, and enriching data from multiple sources. It supports two critical workflows: data integration and advanced analytics. Harmony is designed to serve in global health and development contexts, including HIV, tuberculosis, and malaria programs, supply chain management, emergency response, immunization, and vaccination campaigns. It works with structured data sources typically found in these settings, including health management information systems, logistic management information systems, and survey data. Harmony has been leveraged by governments in low- and middle-income countries in Asia, Africa, and Latin America to improve and manage their health and development programs. The platform enables users to analyze millions of data points at sub-second speed, uncovering insights to inform better decisions.
